answer_1.quote: In abstractive summarization specifically, this approach has arguably opened a new paradigm: summaries generated by LLMs are highly fluent, grammatical and relevant.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with metrics as diverse as possible. First, we consider reference-based metrics: ROUGE-2, BERTScore, and A3CU... As reference-free metrics, we include SummaC...

answer_3.quote: We also leverage GPT-3.5 again (still gpt-3.5-turbo-0125), this time as a summarization evaluator... We prompt the model with the source and generated summary... and ask to output a score on a likert scale from 1 to 5.
